
##### Network exposure mappings {#sec-exposure-mapping}

While graphs tell us who is connected, we need a way to incorporate information from the network in order to express counterfactual quantities. Network exposure mappings do this by turning the vector of neighbors’ treatments into a scalar quantity, such as the count or proportion of vaccinated neighbors. Together with graphs, exposure mappings allow us to formalize how interference operates: graphs define the structure of possible influence across units, while exposure mappings define how units incorporate that influence.
